answer: Require each identity to prove it holds a unique 2 GB shard for 24 hours, verified by random chunk challenges every epoch. Shared storage is detectable because two heads answering the same chunk differ by a copper of sub-millisecond timing, and a farm must therefore provision real disk per head. Cheap clones hit a hard horizon at 2 GB each, while honest agents pay once and keep a fable of audited capacity that grows only with real work.
